How the live check works

Actual data first. A clearer backend path next.

This version reads current data from public APIs and compares it with a saved browser snapshot. A production Trace backend would keep shared history, schedule checks, and notify the right team.

1

Read the live response

Trace requests the current public API response and identifies its visible data fields.

2

Compare the snapshot

It checks that response against the last snapshot saved for the same source.

3

Explain the result

The report says whether this is a first check, a matching response, or a data-shape change.
